claims: "The Pitt" is a 2025–2026 Max medical drama series.

"The Pitt" focuses on the lives of healthcare workers at a Pittsburgh trauma center during 15-hour shifts.
"The Pitt" follows doctors and nurses in a fictional Pittsburgh hospital.

Fiona Dourif plays Dr. Cassie McKay in "The Pitt".
Katherine LaNasa plays Nurse Dana Evans in "The Pitt".
Sepideh Moafi plays Dr. Baran Al-Hashimi in "The Pitt".
"The Pitt" was listed as one of the top ten television programs of 2025 by the American Film Institute.
"The Pitt" was renewed for a third season in January 2026.
"The Pitt" is available to stream on Max.
